versions.changelog:
Initial release of hat-designer skill for AI-driven hat and cap customization.

- Generate customized hat/cap designs for print and manufacturing on demand.
- Supports structured clothing parameters, reference images, custom text, and logos.
- Provides interactive 3D viewers and multi-view design generation.
- Integrates with the Craftsman Agent platform for supplier and manufacturing workflows.
- Uses OneKey Gateway API key for secure access.
